svg.text: Sprite-stacked gothic ground and wall pieces. 1 unit = 1 px at zoom 1. Dark base to lit top, 1 px outline #08080a, sun north-west. Decoration only: no collision, no walk cost, no meaning in the fight.
Vignettes: one dressed hall per biome family (zoom 2)
A split in the flagstone with a raised, chipped lip.
A damp cushion of moss on a joint.
Three long bones and a rib, lying where they fell.
A lone skull, jaw slack, one socket in shadow.
A low heap of broken stone, five chunks.
A cut block and a half block, mortar still on one face.
A tilted slab with a cross cut into it.
A ring cut into the floor with four marks; dull, not lit.
Standing water, grey and dull; never the water blue of a
A knot of roots breaking the flagstone.
A soft drift of ash and dead leaves against the wind.
A blade snapped at the middle, hilt a hand away.
A heap of iron chain and one open shackle.
A cracked clay urn on its side, spilling ash.
Wall pieces (12), on the face under a lit wall top
A hanging banner, hem torn to three tongues, a crest in dull
An iron bracket holding a dead torch.
The same bracket with a flame: a fire light, `#ffb060`,
Ivy climbing from the foot, in leaf runs.
A chain from a ring, ending in an empty cuff.
A long fracture with a flaked edge.
A barred vent, five bars, dark behind. Never a door.
A niche with three candles; a small fire light, radius 90.
A shallow relief panel: a hooded figure with bowed head.
A web in a corner, thin and pale.
A damp run of moss down a joint, thickest at the foot.
A dented iron shield nailed up, boss and rim.
